# Worker in sc_authority_discovery - Rust

Source: https://docs.rs/sc-authority-discovery/0.59.0/sc_authority_discovery/struct.Worker.html

`pub struct Worker<Client, Block: `[BlockT](https://docs.rs/sp-runtime/48.0.0/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/sp_runtime/traits/trait.Block.html), DhtEventStream> { /* private fields */ }## Expand description

An authority discovery [ Worker](https://docs.rs/struct.Worker.html) can publish the local node’s addresses as well as discover
those of other nodes via a Kademlia DHT.

When constructed with [ Role::PublishAndDiscover](https://docs.rs/enum.Role.html#variant.PublishAndDiscover) a

[will](https://docs.rs/struct.Worker.html)

`Worker`-
Retrieve its external addresses (including peer id).
-
Get the list of keys owned by the local node participating in the current authority set.
-
Sign the addresses with the keys.
-
Put addresses and signature as a record with the authority id as a key on a Kademlia DHT.

When constructed with either [ Role::PublishAndDiscover](https://docs.rs/enum.Role.html#variant.PublishAndDiscover) or

[a](https://docs.rs/enum.Role.html#variant.Discover)

`Role::Discover`[will](https://docs.rs/struct.Worker.html)

`Worker`-
Retrieve the current and next set of authorities.
-
Start DHT queries for the ids of the authorities.
-
Validate the signatures of the retrieved key value pairs.
-
Add the retrieved external addresses as priority nodes to the network peerset.
-
Allow querying of the collected addresses via the `crate::Service`

# Service in sc_authority_discovery - Rust

Source: https://docs.rs/sc-authority-discovery/0.59.0/sc_authority_discovery/struct.Service.html

`pub struct Service { /* private fields */ }`## Implementations[§](https://docs.rs#implementations)

Get the addresses for the given [ AuthorityId](https://docs.rs/sp-authority-discovery/43.0.0/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/sp_authority_discovery/type.AuthorityId.html) from the local address
cache.

Returns `None` if no entry was present or connection to the
[ crate::Worker](https://docs.rs/struct.Worker.html) failed.

Note: [ Multiaddr](https://docs.rs/sc-network-types/0.22.0/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/sc_network_types/multiaddr/struct.Multiaddr.html)s returned always include a

[via a](https://docs.rs/sc-network-types/0.22.0/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/sc_network_types/peer_id/struct.PeerId.html)

`PeerId`[component. Equality of](https://docs.rs/sc-network-types/0.22.0/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/sc_network_types/multiaddr/protocol/enum.Protocol.html#variant.P2p)

`sc_network_types::multiaddr::Protocol::P2p`[s across](https://docs.rs/sc-network-types/0.22.0/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/sc_network_types/peer_id/struct.PeerId.html)

`PeerId`[s returned by a single call is not enforced today, given that there are still authorities out there publishing the addresses of their sentry nodes on the DHT. In the future this guarantee can be provided.](https://docs.rs/sc-network-types/0.22.0/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/sc_network_types/multiaddr/struct.Multiaddr.html)

`Multiaddr`## Trait Implementations[§](https://docs.rs#trait-implementations)

# WorkerConfig in sc_authority_discovery - Rust

Source: https://docs.rs/sc-authority-discovery/0.59.0/sc_authority_discovery/struct.WorkerConfig.html

```
pub struct WorkerConfig {
    pub max_publish_interval:
```
[Duration](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/time/struct.Duration.html),
    pub keystore_refresh_interval: [Duration](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/time/struct.Duration.html),
    pub max_query_interval: [Duration](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/time/struct.Duration.html),
    pub publish_non_global_ips: [bool](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.bool.html),
    pub public_addresses: [Vec](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/alloc/vec/struct.Vec.html)<[Multiaddr](https://docs.rs/sc-network-types/0.22.0/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/sc_network_types/multiaddr/struct.Multiaddr.html)>,
    pub strict_record_validation: [bool](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.bool.html),
    pub persisted_cache_directory: [Option](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/option/enum.Option.html)<[PathBuf](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/path/struct.PathBuf.html)>,
}## Fields[§](https://docs.rs#fields)

[§](https://docs.rs#structfield.max_publish_interval)

`max_publish_interval: `[Duration](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/time/struct.Duration.html)The maximum interval in which the node will publish its own address on the DHT.

By default this is set to 1 hour.

[§](https://docs.rs#structfield.keystore_refresh_interval)

`keystore_refresh_interval: `[Duration](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/time/struct.Duration.html)Interval at which the keystore is queried. If the keys have changed, unconditionally re-publish its addresses on the DHT.

By default this is set to 1 minute.

[§](https://docs.rs#structfield.max_query_interval)

`max_query_interval: `[Duration](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/time/struct.Duration.html)The maximum interval in which the node will query the DHT for new entries.

By default this is set to 10 minutes.

[§](https://docs.rs#structfield.publish_non_global_ips)

`publish_non_global_ips: `[bool](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.bool.html)If `false`, the node won’t publish on the DHT multiaddresses that contain non-global
IP addresses (such as 10.0.0.1).

Recommended: `false` for live chains, and `true` for local chains or for testing.

Defaults to `true` to avoid the surprise factor.

[§](https://docs.rs#structfield.public_addresses)

`public_addresses: `[Vec](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/alloc/vec/struct.Vec.html)<[Multiaddr](https://docs.rs/sc-network-types/0.22.0/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/sc_network_types/multiaddr/struct.Multiaddr.html)>Public addresses set by the node operator to always publish first in the authority discovery DHT record.

[§](https://docs.rs#structfield.strict_record_validation)

`strict_record_validation: `[bool](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.bool.html)Reject authority discovery records that are not signed by their network identity (PeerId)

Defaults to `false` to provide compatibility with old versions

[§](https://docs.rs#structfield.persisted_cache_directory)

`persisted_cache_directory: `[Option](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/option/enum.Option.html)<[PathBuf](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/path/struct.PathBuf.html)>The directory of where the persisted AddrCache file is located,
optional since NetworkConfiguration’s `net_config_path` field
is optional. If None, we won’t persist the AddrCache at all.
